entities.name: Catedral de Nossa Senhora do Paraíso
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Catedral de Nossa Senhora do Paraíso is a church located in São Paulo, Brazil and is the seat of the Melkite Greek Catholic Eparchy of Nossa Senhora do Paraíso em São Paulo. The temple is located in the neighborhood of Paraíso in the city of São Paulo and was constructed in 1952.
